verdict.rationale: AI recaps of missed conversations are a fair question for a chat platform like Discord, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a native AI summary or recap feature for channels or threads. The pack only describes threads themselves and developer building blocks (bots, the Gateway API, the REST API) that a third party could use to build summarization, and these earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries and recaps of channels and threads I missed
